Ensure a clearly rounded short U-shaped lower yellow head that immediately meets the raised and broadened existing neckline, featuring a very short broad neck transition and minimal throat exposure. Avoid separate yellow neck shafts, pointed V funnels, pinched collars, neck rolls, floating collars, clipping, or cream belly bibs. Preserve coherent front and rear collar overlap with contact shadows. Retain the complete tilted dark frame, opaque photographic backing in its actual primary color, and the attached lower-right cream note with faint indistinct upper marks and actual overlap. All solid surfaces must be opaque, with alpha only outside the complete card silhouette. Do not invent insignia, text, or accessories. Keep fine primary details understated and indistinct where they are in the source. Maintain the actual near-frontal mild primary angle, head roll, grey light, and crop.
Maintain green-ringed black eyes and source-matching mouth. Preserve actual upper-lip moustache and chin beard only where source shows them; otherwise keep smooth clean chin.
FINAL EXACT SOURCE REQUIREMENT: Actual white/cream and muted RED patterned draped HEAD-CLOTH with BLACK/GOLD horizontal headband fittings. Preserve real DARK thick eyebrow HAIR, full BLACK/DARK upper-lip MOUSTACHE plus DARK CHIN BEARD with source-limited grey highlights, serious CLOSED mouth and no spectacles. Dark BROWN/BLACK outer robe with source-exposed cream/gold trim over PALE WHITE inner garment, no invented civilian tie or military tunic. Preserve actual near-frontal/mild primary angle, head roll, grey light/crop and note-limited visible fabric; no hidden large decorations.
Retain exact primary head angle, expression, cap shape, real hair and visible clothing/decoration areas. One compact near-round yellow mascot head with a clearly ROUNDED short chin immediately contacting raised broad collar, no V-shaped lower-face funnel or yellow shaft. Preserve actual dark solid cloth and photographic backing opacity. Tiny ambiguous features remain understated; no new badge engraving or decorations hidden behind note. Image1 exact original card; Image2 mascot identity/anatomy only.

The photographic BACKING INSIDE the frame is a required OPAQUE surface: preserve its original background color and texture behind the character all the way to the inner frame rim. Never turn the gaps between frame and character into transparent holes or a window. Keep the actual frame angle and rim. Preserve an overlapping paper note, pin or other attachment ONLY when actually visible in this exact source; otherwise do not invent one. Do not invent a new backdrop outside the whole card. Retain source clothing, hair, headgear, lighting and crop at full generated resolution. All originally OPAQUE subject surfaces must remain FULLY OPAQUE (alpha 255): yellow head/body, hair, beard, dark or black clothing, coat lapels, collar, tie, buttons and decorations. Dark cloth is colored material, not transparent background. Never fade garment interiors into semi-transparent patches, holes, white haze or see-through fabric. Keep any genuine source outer-edge alpha falloff only at that actual exterior boundary; preserve actual source transparency rather than making the subject itself translucent.
